title: Standalone Coordination File contains no physical modeled elements
test_intent: Determine whether the governed Standalone Coordination File contains any modeled physical building elements beyond its permitted spatial-authority content.

applicability.applies_when: The tested subject is the governed Standalone Coordination File for a project.
applicability.not_applicable_when: The tested subject is not the governed Standalone Coordination File.

required_evidence: tested container identity confirming Standalone Coordination File designation
complete inventory of model elements or governed element categories in the tested container
governed classification of permitted spatial-authority elements versus prohibited physical building elements

result_logic.pass: The tested Standalone Coordination File contains no modeled physical building elements and contains only content permitted for its governed spatial-authority function.
result_logic.fail: One or more modeled physical building elements are present in the governed Standalone Coordination File.
result_logic.not_applicable: The subject is not the governed Standalone Coordination File.
result_logic.indeterminate: A complete element inventory cannot be obtained or the evidence cannot reliably distinguish permitted spatial-authority elements from physical building elements.

provenance.migration_note: First conformance pilot ATS. This is a strong candidate for a future Revit/ZEN ETS because the normative condition can be evaluated from model content without changing S6 authority.
